mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate is below 5.0% (a condition always true as of 2023-10-15), which signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of the time periods (which are all time periods), or the Rank IC for the signal (FEDFUNDS < 5.0%) is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% within the next 3 months, it signals an impending economic slowdown that increases equity risk premiums and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (when UNRATE > 4.5%), or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 4.5% is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 3.0% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is not declining (i.e., FEDFUNDS change in last 3 months <= 0.0%), it signals a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain high rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom (HOUST > 1250), when residential fixed investment (RSAFS) is above 500000, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1250 AND RSAFS > 500000, or the Rank IC for the signal (RSAFS > 500000 in HOUST>1250 regime) is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months, it signals a weakening economy that increases equity risk and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for INDPRO decline > 0.5% is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months, it signals a strong housing market and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for HOUST rise > 0.5% is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5% over the past 3 months and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) declines by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong economy with accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 1.0%, it signals robust economic expansion that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 growth > 1.0% is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
